episodes.synopsis: An awkward otaku is surprised to find himself becoming friends with two of the most popular girls at school.
episodes.title: Can a Gal Be Kind to Otaku?

episodes.synopsis: Ijichi and Amane insist on visiting Seo's house after school for an impromptu Glittery Monpets viewing party.
episodes.title: Is My Room a Hangout Spot for Gals?!

episodes.synopsis: Quiet otaku Takuya suddenly befriends two very different gals, bonding with them over anime and fandom.
episodes.title: Do You Want to Come Over?

episodes.synopsis: After an intense sports day at school, the gals take Seo out for an afternoon of Glittermon songs at karaoke.
episodes.title: Let's Go to Karaoke

episodes.synopsis: Seo and the gals enjoy a sunny day at the beach with three of Ijichi's brothers and Amane's young friend Sayu.
episodes.title: So? You Like Our Swimsuits?

episodes.synopsis: Amane asks Seo to help out at a photo shoot and then the three friends visit a festival with a fireworks show.
episodes.title: Love?

episodes.synopsis: Otaku-kun and the gals brainstorm cosplay ideas for the upcoming school festival.
episodes.title: You're a Real Pickup Artist, Otaku-kun

episodes.synopsis: Ijichi has Seo and Amane over to work on festival preparations but they end up having a slumber party instead.
episodes.title: A Slumber Party? No Way!

episodes.synopsis: After the sleepover, Ijichi and Amane recall the first time they met and the early days of their friendship.
episodes.title: This Was Your Idea, Kotoko Ijichi!

episodes.synopsis: Seo, Amane, and Ijichi finally get to show the class the costumes they put so much time and effort into.
episodes.title: The School Festival!!

episodes.synopsis: Second day of the school festival brings more events, more guests, and more fun for Seo and his gal friends.
episodes.title: Zing!

episodes.synopsis: Seo disappears during the closing activities so Ijichi and Amane go looking for him to see if he is all right.
episodes.title: Oh, Come On, Otaku-kun
